description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for low level internal ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) operations in the firmware, including function prototypes for ADC initialization, data retrieval, and conversion utilities. It also contains macro definitions and conditional compilation directives specific to ADC handling.

classes.name: adc_state
classes.description: Structure representing a snapshot of ADC data with a buffer for multiple channel samples.

methods.name: getAdcMode
methods.description: Returns the mode string for a given hardware ADC channel.

methods.name: initAdcInputs
methods.description: Initializes ADC inputs with an optional board test mode.

methods.name: getAdcChannelPin
methods.description: Gets the pin associated with a particular ADC channel.

methods.name: getAdcChannelPort
methods.description: Gets the port associated with an ADC channel, with an additional message parameter for context.

methods.name: getAdcChannel
methods.description: Returns the ADC channel corresponding to a specific brain pin.

methods.name: getAdcChannelBrainPin
methods.description: Returns the brain pin associated with a particular ADC channel.

methods.name: waitForSlowAdc
methods.description: Blocks until at least one slow ADC sample is completed.

methods.name: getSlowAdcCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the count of completed slow ADC samples.

methods.name: getAdcHardwareIndexByInternalIndex
methods.description: Maps an internal index to the hardware ADC index.

methods.name: printFullAdcReportIfNeeded
methods.description: Outputs a detailed ADC report if conditions require it.

methods.name: getInternalAdcValue
methods.description: Returns the internal ADC value for a given channel with context.

methods.name: getMCUInternalTemperature
methods.description: Reads the internal temperature of the MCU.
